GAMEPLAY CHANGES

Assassins have been struggling to turn early leads into wins, even when they manage to get ahead. We're making a series of changes to their items and runes.

Items

Youmuu's Ghostblade

Base Stats

  • Price: 3000 → 2900

Locket of the Iron Solari

We're giving Locket of the Iron Solari a boost to make it a more appealing option for tank supports. This should help tank supports better protect their carries and close the gap between playing alongside a tank support versus an enchanter.

Base Stats

  • Price: 2600 → 2500
  • Health: 200 → 300

Thornmail

Thornmail has been offering a little too much value for its cost, giving tanks access to a large amount of Armor and Grievous Wounds earlier than intended. We're adjusting its cost to better align with other first completed items.

Base Stats

  • Price: 2700 → 2850

Warmog's Armor

Warmog's Armor has been finding its way into a few too many builds, especially among enchanter supports.

Warmog’s Heart

  • Trigger threshold: 900 → 1250

Statikk Shiv

Statikk Shiv hasn't quite kept up with other item options, so we're giving it a small boost.

Base Stats

  • Price: 3000→2900
  • Attacks grant extra Energized stacks: 5 → 7

Yun Tal Wildarrows

Yun Tal Wildarrows is still struggling to keep up with other marksman items. We're lowering its cost.

Base Stats

  • Price: 3100 → 3000
